lead: Shashikala was a film actor, born on 4 August 1932 in Solapur.
She died on 4 April 2021 in Mumbai at the age of 88.
She has 24 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress and Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress.
This profile collects the Shashikala facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Shashikala — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shashikala was born on 4 August 1932 in Solapur, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India. She was given the name Shashikala Jawalkar at birth and is publicly known as Shashikala.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.
